incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: service=latency-slo-us-west, symptom=p99>1500ms for 5m, alerts=3; paging oncall
alice-oncall: acked
riley-ops: I'm on it, checking regional egress and queue depths
alice-oncall: thanks — can you confirm whether this is across models or a single model shard?
marc-eng: quick metric: cpu on shard-7 spiked to 92%, nvlink errors ~0.1%, requests per second up 2.3x
riley-ops: looks like hotkey on /generate for model-redwood-7b; kv-cache hit rate dropped 18%
alice-oncall: rolling a targeted cache warmup for shard-7 now (runbook step 3)
sre-runbook-bot: runbook 'latency/p99-burn' invoked by alice-oncall — warming prefixes, increasing max_batch=8 for shard-7
marc-eng: pushed short-term throttle on heavy clients: curl -XPOST /admin/clients/throttle -d '{"client":"crawler-ef" , "rate":10}' (applied)
zoe-cs: any PII or customer-facing impact? Retaining customers on chat paths reported timeouts but no errors logged
alice-oncall: issuing softpage to PD (suppress full escalation) — note: customer-facing latency spike, but most requests still succeeding
riley-ops: after warmup qps back down to baseline, p99 trending down from 1600ms -> 720ms in 3 min
marc-eng: keeping cache-warms for 10m; will prepare model-variant fallback if p99 stays >1s
alice-oncall: keeping thread open; if p99 stabilizes <800ms by next check I'll close the softpage. otherwise escalate to senior oncall
sre-runbook-bot: scheduled check-in in 5m
alice-oncall: :thumbsup: thanks team — documenting timeline for postmortem
zoe-cs: passing a quick customer note to #cs-alerts: "We've seen transient latency.. monitoring and mitigation applied."
